minutes.headline: Planning Board reorganized, filled committee seats, and let a 68 Elm Street common driveway be withdrawn to be redrawn.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board elected officers (chair, vice chair, clerk) and made committee appointments, with two new members. It spent a long stretch on a common driveway application at 68 Elm Street that the board's members felt did not meet the bylaw, and the applicant withdrew it. The board also appointed members to the Economic Development and Open Space committees and reviewed the stormwater bylaw changes, which were left on the agenda for the new members.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board elected a chair, vice chair and clerk by roll call, with two new members seated.
The board accepted the withdrawal of a common driveway application at 68 Elm Street after members said it did not meet the bylaw.
The applicant is to redraw the driveway to straddle the lot line, which needs no further Planning Board approval.
The board made appointments to the Economic Development Committee and the Open Space committee, and to town-wide committees such as capital planning and stormwater.
The stormwater bylaw changes stayed on the ongoing agenda so the new members can review them before fall Town Meeting.

why_it_matters: A redrawn driveway that straddles the lot line skips Planning Board review, so a neighbor on Elm Street would get no public hearing on it.
The stormwater bylaw changes may reach fall Town Meeting, where residents would be asked to vote on them.
watch_next: Planning Board review of the stormwater bylaw changes ahead of fall Town Meeting.
A meeting of the Open Space committee, which the board wants held as soon as possible.

reconciliation.summary: The records agree on most officer elections and committee appointments, but differ on the Capital Planning Committee appointment, the 68 Elm Street driveway outcome, the Agricultural Commission liaison, and the Open Space vote count. A reader should check the Capital Planning appointment first: ours has Jorgensen passing, while the official minutes show a failed motion for Allison and then Torgersen passing.
